design.scope: Fixed development stress tests, not independent calibration. Geometry and all thresholds frozen before inspecting results. Missing-core truth adds a cap invisible to every observation. No preferred global estimate is expected.

support.definition: Exact-site Delaunay triangles: longest edge / minimum vertex third-neighbor distance and circumdiameter / median vertex third-neighbor distance both <= spacing factor.
